data.title: Income Tax Assessment 2025 (Einkommensteuerbescheid)
data.summary: Finanzamt Beispiel-Merzig assessed the 2025 income tax at €3,014.00, resulting in a refund (Guthaben) of €654.00 to be paid into the recipient's bank account, with the option to file an objection (Einspruch) within one month of deemed delivery.
data.explanation: This is the official income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 from the Finanzamt. It lists income, deductible expenses and the tax owed; since more wage tax was withheld than assessed, a refund of €654.00 will be transferred automatically to the account on file — no action is needed for that. If the assessment seems wrong (for example the amount recognised for the training/Fortbildung costs), an objection (Einspruch) may be filed with the Finanzamt; the app shows the deadline it computed. If no objection is filed in time, the assessment becomes final and binding.

remedy.form_text: Richten Sie den Einspruch schriftlich oder elektronisch an das Finanzamt Beispiel-Merzig; Sie können ihn dort auch zu Protokoll geben.
remedy.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.
